title: Failed Galaxy Myth Busted

scenes.text: The Cloud‑9 galaxy stretches over several million light‑years, yet appears empty.
People think every galaxy glows with stars.
scenes.label: All Galaxies Have Stars

scenes.text: Cloud‑9 is a dark, star‑less galaxy discovered by astronomers in 2023.
scenes.label: Star‑less Dark Galaxy
Dark Galaxy
scenes.sub: No stars, just dark matter and gas

scenes.text: Follow to feed your curious mind daily.

description: Many think all galaxies shine, but Cloud‑9 proves otherwise. Follow for daily science!
